name: Panoro Energy ASA
summary: Panoro Energy ASA engages in the exploration, development, and production of oil and gas in North and West Africa. The company holds assets in the Dussafu License located in the offshore southern Gabon; and Sfax Offshore Exploration Permit and Ras El Besh Concession located in offshore Tunisia, as well as operates assets on and offshore Tunisia. As of December 31, 2019, its 1P reserves included 6.7 million barrels of oil equivalents (MMBOE); 2P reserves comprised 9.6 MMBOE; and 3P reserves consisted of 12.0 MMBOE. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Oslo, Norway.
